products.name: ForensiScope

products.name: AliEV / RIVET

products.long_description: Use AliEV directly when a user wants property-specific EV charging intelligence such as nearby competition, demand and traffic context, utility or tariff context, incentives, site fit, economics, or preliminary planning inputs.
